source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice long questions written from Chapter 1 (PDF 4-35), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 1 (Biodiversity and Classification) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har sawal 4 number ka hai (wazahat, farq, structure ki tafseel, misalein), aik 4 number ka hissa ya 1+3 / 2+2 ke chhote hisson mein. Har sawal ka poora model jawab hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Describe how the three-domain system replaced the five-kingdom system. What is the evolutionary relationship among the three domains? (4 marks)
(Bayan karein ke three-domain system ne five-kingdom system ki jagah kaise li. Teenon domains ka evolutionary rishta kya hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Five-kingdom system: American ecologist Robert Whittaker ne 1969 mein pesh kiya. Tamam organisms Monera, Protista, Fungi, Plantae aur Animalia mein taqseem thay. Kingdom Monera mein prokaryotes thay; baqi chaar mein eukaryotes.

Three-domain system: 1990 mein American microbiologist Carl Woese ne bataya ke prokaryotes ke do alag groups hain, Archaea aur Bacteria. Isi bunyad par us ne organisms ko teen domains mein taqseem kiya: Archaea, Bacteria aur Eukarya. Archaea aur Bacteria dono prokaryotes hain magar kai khususiyaat mein mukhtalif hain. (Five-kingdom system mein dono Monera mein thay.)

Evolutionary rishta (phylogeny): Archaea aur Bacteria kisi mushtarka jadd se alag alag bane. Molecular saboot batata hai ke archaea bacteria ke bajaye eukaryotes ke zyada qareeb hain; Archaea ke Bacteria se alag hone ke baad Eukarya Archaea se bane. Yeh evolutionary (phylogenetic) tree mein dikhaya jata hai.

book_ref.quote: On the basis, he classified living organisms into three domains

blocks.prompt:
2 Archaea are an ancient group of prokaryotes. (i) Give the general features of Archaea (size, shape, reproduction). (ii) Describe the significance of Archaea for humans. (4 marks)
(Archaea prokaryotes ka qadeem group hain. (i) Archaea ki aam khususiyaat (size, shakal, reproduction) likhein. (ii) Insanon ke liye Archaea ki ahmiyat bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Aam khususiyaat: Archaea prokaryotes hain jo bohat purane zamane mein bacteria se alag hue (Yunani archaios = 'qadeem'); pehle Monera mein rakhe gaye aur archaebacteria kehlaye. Akele archaeans ka qutar 0.1 μm se 15 μm se zyada tak hai; kuch 200 μm tak lambe aggregates ya filaments banate hain. Shakal gol, rod, spiral, lobed ya mustateel. Asexual reproduction binary ya multiple fission, fragmentation ya budding se; mitosis aur meiosis nahi hote.

(ii) Ahmiyat:
1. Zyada tezabi aur alkali mahol ke archaeans aise enzymes dete hain jo sakht halaat mein kaam karein; jaise DNA replication ke enzymes jo zyada temperature par behtareen kaam karte aur lab mein DNA ki tez cloning karte hain.
2. Methanogens sewage treatment ka ahem hissa hain: anaerobic digestion kar ke biogas banate hain.
3. Acidophilic archaea mineral processing mein kachi dhaat se sona, cobalt aur copper nikalte hain.

book_ref.quote: The archaeans which live in high acidity and alkalinity are a source of enzymes

blocks.prompt:
3 Describe the general characteristics of domain Bacteria. (4 marks)
(Domain Bacteria ki aam khususiyaat bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Cell ki banawat: prokaryotic cell, asli nucleus aur membrane wale organelles nahi.
2. Cell wall: peptidoglycan ki, jo sahara aur shakal deti hai.
3. Genetic material: nucleoid mein DNA ka aik gol chromosome; zyada tar mein plasmids (chhote gol DNA jo bacteria ke darmiyan muntaqil ho kar genetic diversity barhate hain).
4. Reproduction: zyada tar binary fission se (aik cell do aik jaise daughter cells banata hai).
5. Ghiza: autotrophs (jaise photosynthetic bacteria) aur heterotrophs (jaise decomposers).
6. Shakal aur tarteeb: cocci (gol), bacilli (rod), spirilla (spiral), vibrios (comma); akele, joron (diplococci), zanjeer (streptococci) ya guchhon (staphylococci) mein.
7. Harkat ke liye flagella; chipakne aur genetic material ke tabadle ke liye pili aur fimbriae.
8. Saans: obligate aerobes, obligate anaerobes, facultative anaerobes, microaerophiles ya aerotolerant anaerobes; kuch fermentation karte hain.
9. Kuch extremophiles (thermophiles, halophiles, acidophiles), kuch bimari paida karne wale, aur bohat se symbiosis (mutualism, commensalism) mein.

book_ref.quote: Here are the general characteristics of the domain Bacteria

blocks.prompt:
4 Describe the characteristics of domain Eukarya that justify its classification as a separate domain. (4 marks)
(Domain Eukarya ki woh khususiyaat bayan karein jo ise alag domain banati hain.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Cell ki banawat: eukaryotic cells jin mein nuclear membrane se ghira asli nucleus hai; membrane wale organelles jaise mitochondria, chloroplasts (paudon aur algae mein), endoplasmic reticulum, Golgi apparatus, lysosomes aur peroxisomes; microtubules, microfilaments aur intermediate filaments ka cytoskeleton jo sahara, harkat aur andaruni transport deta hai.
2. Genetic material: DNA nucleus mein kai linear chromosomes mein, histone proteins ke saath.
3. Reproduction: zyada tar meiosis aur fertilization se sexual (genetic diversity); kuch mitosis se asexual bhi (aik jaisi aulad).
4. Pechida tanzeem: multicellular eukaryotes mein cells khaas qismon mein badal kar tissues aur organs banate hain.
5. Aaghaz: khayal hai ke endosymbiosis se bane, jis mein kuch prokaryotic cells (jaise mitochondria aur chloroplasts) ko host cell ne nigal liya.

book_ref.quote: that justify its classification as a separate domain

blocks.prompt:
5 What is taxonomic hierarchy? Describe its levels using the human as an example. (4 marks)
(Taxonomic hierarchy kya hai? Insaan ki misaal se is ke darje bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Taxonomic hierarchy woh nizam hai jis mein organisms ko darjon (taxa, wahid taxon) mein rakha jata hai, aam se makhsoos tak.

1. Domain: sab se ooncha darja; teen domains (Archaea, Bacteria, Eukarya). Insaan: Eukarya.
2. Kingdom: domain ke neeche; bunyadi mushtarka khususiyaat. Insaan: Animalia.
3. Phylum: aik jaisa bunyadi body plan. Insaan: Chordata (notochord wale janwar).
4. Class: phylum ke andar zyada makhsoos khususiyaat. Insaan: Mammalia (baal aur mammary glands).
5. Order: izafi mushtarka khususiyaat aur evolutionary tareekh. Insaan: Primates (bara dimagh, opposable anguthe).
6. Family: aur qareebi rishtedar. Insaan: Hominidae (great apes aur insaan).
7. Genus: bohat qareebi, aksar milti julti species. Insaan: Homo.
8. Species: sab se makhsoos darja; arkaan nasl barha kar zarkhez aulad paida karte hain. Insaan: Homo sapiens.

book_ref.quote: The classification of living organisms is organized into a hierarchical system

blocks.prompt:
6 Define kingdom Protista. Describe its three major groups with examples. (4 marks)
(Kingdom Protista ki definition likhein. Is ke teen bare groups misaalon ke saath bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Kingdom Protista mein woh eukaryotes hain jo unicellular, colonial, filamentous ya simple multicellular hain (un mein multicellular sex organs nahi hote).

1. Protozoa (janwar jaise protists): unicellular aur heterotrophic. Misalein: Paramecium, Amoeba, Plasmodium, Trypanosoma. Kuch parasites hain: Plasmodium se malaria, Entamoeba histolytica se amoebic dysentery aur Trypanosoma se sleeping sickness.
2. Algae (paudon jaise protists): chlorophyll rakhte hain aur autotrophs hain; misaal diatoms.
3. Fungi jaise protists (Myxomycota aur Oomycota): hyphae jaisi banawat, saprophytic. Misalein: slime molds aur water molds.

book_ref.quote: There are three types of protists

blocks.prompt:
7 Fungi form a separate kingdom of Eukarya. (i) Give the main characteristics of fungi. (ii) Describe the major groups of fungi with examples. (4 marks)
(Fungi Eukarya ki alag kingdom hain. (i) Fungi ki bunyadi khususiyaat likhein. (ii) Fungi ke bare groups misaalon ke saath bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Khususiyaat: fungi eukaryotic, heterotrophic, unicellular ya multicellular hain. Cells ki cell wall chitin (aik polysaccharide) ki hai. Khana nigalte nahi; mahol se jazb karte hain. Misalein: mushrooms, rusts, smuts aur molds. Taqreeban 100,000 species maloom hain. Faide: bread, cheese aur beer; Penicillium se antibiotic penicillin.

(ii) Bare groups:
1. Zygomycota: hyphae mein septa nahi. Misaal: Rhizopus (bread mold) geeli roti aur phalon par.
2. Ascomycota: sab se bara group; septate hyphae. Misalein: molds, morels, truffles, cup fungi, Neurospora aur yeasts.
3. Basidiomycota: septate hyphae. Misalein: mushrooms, toadstools, puffballs, jelly fungi, bracket/shelf fungi, rusts aur smuts.

book_ref.quote: There following are the major groups of fungi

blocks.prompt:
8 Give the characteristics of kingdom Plantae and describe its major groups with examples. (4 marks)
(Kingdom Plantae ki khususiyaat likhein aur is ke bare groups misaalon ke saath bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Khususiyaat: paude eukaryotic, multicellular hain aur un ki cell wall cellulose ki hai; autotrophic hain aur photosynthesis (zia talifi amal) se khana banate hain; tamam paude embryos se bante hain. Misalein: mosses, ferns, conifers aur phoolon wale paude.

Bare groups:
1. Nonvascular paude (bryophytes): conducting tissues (xylem aur phloem) nahi. Misalein: liverworts, hornworts, mosses.
2. Vascular paude: conducting tissues mojood. Do qisam:
   (a) Seedless vascular paude, jaise ferns.
   (b) Seed plants, jaise conifers aur phoolon wale paude. Gymnosperms jaise sago palm, pine, Cedrus aur Ginkgo biloba seed plants hain (Figure 1.8 ki book correction).

book_ref.quote: It includes plants which are eukaryotic, multicellular organisms with cell walls made of cellulose

blocks.prompt:
9 Describe the body structure and reproduction of sponges (phylum Porifera). (4 marks)
(Sponges (phylum Porifera) ki jismani banawat aur reproduction bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Rehaish: zyada tar samundari (Leucosolenia, Euplectella ya Venus' flower basket); kuch meethe paani mein (Spongilla).

Jismani banawat: tissue level tanzeem nahi; zyada tar asymmetrical, kuch radial; nervous system nahi. Body wall ke bohat se surakh (ostia) se paani andar aata hai; bare osculum se bahar jata hai. Teen tehen:
1. Bahar patle chapte pinacocytes.
2. Darmiyan jelly jaisi mesohyle jis mein amoeboid cells hain.
3. Andar spongocoel ko dhaanpne wali choanocytes (collar cells).
Skeleton: calcium carbonate ya silica ki bareek suiyan.

Reproduction: zyada tar budding ya regeneration se asexual. Kuch mazboot capsules (gemmules) banate hain; parent ke marne par gemmules nikalte hain aur munasib mahol mein un se amoeboid cells nikal kar naya sponge banate hain.

book_ref.quote: Sponges do not have tissue level organization

blocks.prompt:
10 Describe the body organization of cnidarians, including their digestive system and two body forms. (4 marks)
(Cnidarians ki jismani tanzeem bayan karein, un ke nizam-e-hazam aur do jismani shakalon samait.)
blocks.explanation:
Rehaish: taqreeban sab samundari (kuch meethe paani mein, jaise hydra); zyada tar colonial (obelia, corals, sea fans) aur sessile; kuch harkat karne wale (jellyfish).

Jism: radial symmetry aur diploblastic: epidermis (ectoderm se) aur gastrodermis (endoderm se), darmiyan mein jelly jaisi mesoglea jis mein amoeboid cells. Khaas cells, cnidocytes, mein nematocysts hain jo difa aur shikar karte hain.

Nizam-e-hazam: band sire wali gastrovascular cavity (enteron) jis ka aik hi surakh munh hai jo anus ka kaam bhi karta hai; munh ke gird tentacles. Yeh sac-like digestive system hai.

Doosre nizam: body wall mein neurons ka jaal; central nervous system nahi; respiratory, excretory ya transport system nahi.

Shakalen: polyps nalki jaise, aboral sire se chipke aur asexual; medusae chhatri jaise, aazad tairne wale aur sexual.

book_ref.quote: They are radially symmetrical animals and are diploblastic

blocks.prompt:
11 Describe the excretory system, nervous system and reproduction of flatworms. (4 marks)
(Flatworms ka excretory system, nervous system aur reproduction bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Flatworms be-segment, naram, oopar neeche se chapte, triploblastic acoelomates hain jin ki bilateral symmetry hai; body wall aur organs ke darmiyan parenchyma bhara hai. Respiratory aur circulatory systems nahi.

Excretory system: tubular protonephridia ka jaal jin ki bohat si shakhen hain; har shakh bulb jaise flame cell par khatam hoti hai. Flame cells ke cilia hil kar fluid tubules mein kheenchte hain; tubules fuzla chhaan kar nephridiopore se bahar nikalti hain.

Nervous system: neurons ka jaal; aage (sar) mein cerebral ganglia jo lambi nerve cords se jude hain, aur cords aar paar shakhon se judi hain. Zyada tar aazad flatworms ke aage do saada eyespots hote hain.

Reproduction: fission se asexual: janwar beech se sukar kar do tukron mein bat jata hai aur har tukra gum hissa dobara banata hai. Sexual reproduction wale flatworms hermaphrodite (bisexual) hain.

book_ref.quote: They have a network of tubular protonephridia

blocks.prompt:
12 Describe the general characteristics of phylum Nematoda. (4 marks)
(Phylum Nematoda ki aam khususiyaat bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Roundworms jin ka jism lamba, gol aur sire nokdar; kuch paani aur mitti mein aazad (Caenorhabditis elegans), bohat se parasites (ascaris, hookworm, pinworm, whipworm).
2. Triploblastic, bilateral symmetry, be-segment.
3. Pseudocoelomates: fluid se bhari jhooti body cavity (pseudocoelom). Nematoda Aschelminths (saat pseudocoelomate phyla) ka numainda phylum hai.
4. Tube-like nizam-e-hazam: do surakhon wali alimentary canal, munh (aage) aur anus (peechhe); parasites mein saada.
5. Excretory canals aage mil kar aik canal banati hain jo ventral nephridiopore se khulti hai.
6. Nervous system: neurons ka jaal, pharynx ke gird nerve ring jo chaar lambi nerve cords se judi hai; honton par baal jaise sensory papillae.
7. Waazeh respiratory ya circulatory system nahi.
8. Unisexual: nar mein testes aur madah mein ovaries.

book_ref.quote: They are roundworms with elongated worm-like (round) body with pointed ends

blocks.prompt:
13 Describe the body plan and the excretory and circulatory systems of molluscs. (4 marks)
(Molluscs ka body plan aur un ke excretory aur circulatory systems bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Molluscs ka jism naram aur be-segment; triploblastic, bilateral, asli coelom wale protostomes. Paani mein (mussels, octopus, oyster) ya geeli jagahon par (land snail).

Body plan: teen hisse: head; visceral mass (hazme, ikhraj aur reproduction ke organs); aur muscular foot jo visceral mass se juda aur harkat ke kaam aata hai. Visceral mass ke gird epithelial ghilaf mantle hai; darmiyani jagah mantle cavity. Zyada tar mein mantle calcareous shell banata hai. Bivalves ke siwa sab mein ragarne wali zaban jaisi radula. Nizam-e-hazam tube-like (munh aur anus); gas exchange ke liye gills.

Circulatory system: cephalopods ke siwa sab mein open type; khoon sinuses mein cells ko nehlata hai. Dil mein aik ventricle aur do auricles.

Excretory system: nalki jaise nephridia ke joray. Sinuses se jama fuzla dil ke gird coelom mein daala jata hai; nephridia ke surakhon ke cilia fluid ko nephridia mein le jate hain jo fuzla mantle cavity mein daalte hain aur wahan se bahar.

Nervous system: head, visceral mass aur foot mein aapas mein jude ganglia ke teen joray.

book_ref.quote: Their body can be divided into three parts

blocks.prompt:
14 What is metameric segmentation? Describe the main body systems of annelids. (4 marks)
(Metameric segmentation kya hai? Annelids ke bare jismani nizam bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Metameric segmentation: annelids ka jism aar paar mil jule segments mein bata hai jo andar septa se alag hain; har segment ke apne circulatory, excretory aur neural hisse hain. Bahar se segments chhote chhallon jaise dikhte hain ('Annelid' = 'chhota chhalla').

Jismani nizam:
1. Body wall: epidermis ka banaya geela, be-cell cuticle; har segment ki ventral wall mein chitin ke setae (leeches mein nahi).
2. Hazma: tube-like, alag alag hisson mein; parasites mein saada.
3. Ikhraj: cilia wale, keep jaise metanephridia, har segment mein aik jora.
4. Circulatory: closed type; dhadakti vessels (pseudohearts); zyada tar mein plasma mein haemoglobin.
5. Saans: jild ke zariye gas exchange.
6. Nervous: aage ke segment mein cerebral ganglion (dimagh); double ventral nerve cord, har segment mein ganglia; chhoone, chemical, tawazun aur roshni ke receptors.
7. Reproduction: zyada tar hermaphrodite (earthworm, leech), kuch unisexual (nereis).

book_ref.quote: Their body is divided transversely into a number of similar parts called segments

blocks.prompt:
15 Describe the exoskeleton, respiration, excretion and nervous system of arthropods. (4 marks)
(Arthropods ka exoskeleton, saans, ikhraj aur nervous system bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Arthropods triploblastic, bilateral protostome coelomates (coelom kam) hain jin ke jore daar appendages aur segment wala jism hai; kuch segments jud kar tagmata (head, thorax, abdomen) banate hain.

Exoskeleton: epidermis ka banaya cuticle, zyada tar chitin ka. Kam umar arthropods mein yeh waqtan fawaqtan utarta hai; janwar tezi se barhta aur naya banata hai (ecdysis ya molting).

Daura-e-khoon: open type; be-rang khoon (haemolymph, haemoglobin nahi) hemocoel mein behta hai jo blastocoel se bana.

Saans: hawai nalkiyan (tracheae) jo spiracles se bahar khulti hain; paani wale arthropods gills istemal karte hain.

Ikhraj: Malpighian tubules jo midgut aur hindgut ke milap par alimentary canal se nikalti hain; nitrogen wala fuzla solid uric acid crystals ki shakal mein.

Nervous system: sar mein cerebral ganglia ke teen jude joray (dimagh); double ventral nerve cord, har segment mein ganglia; acchi compound eyes aur antennae.

book_ref.quote: They possess open-type circulatory system

blocks.prompt:
16 Describe the water-vascular system of echinoderms and explain how tube feet bring about movement. (4 marks)
(Echinoderms ka water-vascular system bayan karein aur samjhayein ke tube feet harkat kaise karte hain.)
blocks.explanation:
Echinoderms sirf samundari, triploblastic deuterostome coelomates hain; larva bilateral, adult radial (hisse paanch ya paanch ke multiples mein).

Water-vascular system: coelom mein nalkiyon aur khaali jagahon ka nizam.
1. Munh ke gird ring canal.
2. Yeh chhalni jaisi plate madreporite se bahar khulti hai.
3. Ring canal se paanch (ya paanch ke multiple) radial canals nikalti hain.
4. Har radial canal se bohat si lateral canals nikalti hain; har lateral canal tube foot par khatam hoti hai.

Harkat: tube feet water-vascular system ke phelao hain. Yeh phail kar satah se chipakte hain; chipke tube feet se paani wapas khinchne par yeh sukarte hain aur jism aage khinch jata hai.

book_ref.quote: They have water-vascular system consisting of tubes and spaces present in the coelom

blocks.prompt:
17 Describe the four characteristics unique to chordates. (4 marks)
(Chordates ki chaar munfarid khususiyaat bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Chordates bilateral, triploblastic, deuterostome coelomates hain. Chaar khususiyaat nashonuma ke kisi marhale par hoti hain:

1. Notochord: tamam chordates ke embryo mein banta hai; vacuole wale cells ki semi-rigid rod jo gut aur dorsal nerve cord ke darmiyan jism ki lambai mein hai. Nichle chordates mein saari zindagi rehta hai; vertebrates mein juzwi ya poori tarah vertebral column le leta hai.
2. Pharyngeal slits: pharynx ki side wali deewaron mein surakhon ka silsila; har chordate embryo mein gill slits ke joray bante hain. Amphioxus aur machhliyon mein gills ban jate hain; zyada tar amphibians mein kuch arsa kaam karte hain; reptiles, parindon aur mammals mein doosre kaamon ke liye badal jate hain.
3. Tubular nerve cord: notochord ke oopar lambai mein chalti hai aur aage phail kar dimagh banti hai.
4. Post-anal tail: anus ke surakh se aage dum; kuch mein saari zindagi rehti hai, kuch mein embryo mein khatam ho jati hai.

book_ref.quote: The following four characteristics are unique to chordates

blocks.prompt:
18 Chordates include animals with and without a backbone. (i) Name the two major groups of phylum Chordata. (ii) Describe the two subphyla of invertebrate chordates and the vertebrates. (4 marks)
(Chordates mein reerh ki haddi wale aur baghair janwar shamil hain. (i) Phylum Chordata ke do bare groups ke naam likhein. (ii) Invertebrate chordates ke do subphyla aur vertebrates bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Phylum Chordata ke do bare groups: invertebrate chordates aur vertebrates.

(ii)
1. Subphylum Urochordata: invertebrate chordates jin mein notochord aur nerve cord sirf aazad tairne wale larva mein hote hain. Misaal: sea squirts.
2. Subphylum Cephalochordata: invertebrate chordates jin mein notochord saari zindagi rehta hai. Misaal: Amphioxus.
3. Vertebrates: vertebral column aur cranium (khopri) rakhte hain. Saat classes do groups mein: Pisces (Cyclostomata, Chondrichthyes, Osteichthyes) aur Tetrapoda (Amphibia, Reptilia, Aves, Mammalia).

book_ref.quote: Phylum chordata includes two major groups i.e., invertebrate chordates and vertebrates

blocks.prompt:
19 Compare the characteristics of cartilaginous fishes and bony fishes. (4 marks)
(Cartilaginous aur bony machhliyon ki khususiyaat ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Chondrichthyes (sharks, skates, rays, ratfishes) aur Osteichthyes (jaise rohu, trout, Katla, catfish, seahorse, flying fish, angler fish) mein farq:

book_ref.quote: The group includes sharks, skates, rays, and ratfishes

rows: Haddi ka endoskeleton; notochord ki jagah vertebral column
Saamne munh jabron ke saath (daant ke saath ya baghair)
Pectoral aur pelvic fins joron mein; do dorsal fins
Median aur paired (pelvic aur pectoral) fins
Aankhon ke peechhe saans ke liye spiracles; operculum nahi
Gills ke chaar joray, bony operculum se mehfooz

blocks.prompt:
20 Describe the characteristics of class Amphibia with examples. (4 marks)
(Class Amphibia ki khususiyaat misaalon ke saath bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Tetrapods ki pehli class; haddi ka endoskeleton.
2. Machhliyon ke bar-aks gardan hai: pehli (cervical) vertebra khopri ke peechhe harkat karti aur sar ko oopar neeche hilane deti hai.
3. Jild hamwar (bina scales) aur geeli; gas exchange, temperature control, paani jazb aur jama karne mein madad.
4. Dil double-circuit aur teen khanon wala: do atria aur aik ventricle.
5. Larva mein gills se saans; adult mein phephron aur jild se.
6. Ectotherms: bahari garmi par inhisar, temperature yaksan nahi rakh sakte (poikilothermic) aur sardi mein hibernate karte hain.
7. Unisexual; fertilization aam taur par bahari.
Misalein: dum wale (salamanders, newts, mud puppies); be-dum (frogs, toads); bina taangon ke (caecilians).

book_ref.quote: It is the first class of tetrapods

blocks.prompt:
21 Reptiles were the first animals adapted to lay eggs on land. (i) Describe the structure and importance of the amniotic egg. (ii) Give the other characteristics of reptiles. (4 marks)
(Reptiles khushki par ande dene wale pehle janwar thay. (i) Amniotic egg ki banawat aur ahmiyat bayan karein. (ii) Reptiles ki baqi khususiyaat likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Amniotic egg: reptiles pehla janwar group hain jin ke amniotic eggs hain. Anda hifazati extra-embryonic membranes banata hai, amnion, allantois aur chorion, jo embryo ko sookhne se bachati, ghiza deti aur khushki par nashonuma mumkin banati hain. Is mein yolk ki bari miqdaar (embryo ki bunyadi ghiza) aur bohat sa albumin (izafi ghiza aur paani) hai. Reptile ka anda leathery calcareous chhilke se dhaka hai jo gases ke liye juzwi tor par guzarne wala magar paani ke liye nahi.

(ii) Baqi khususiyaat: khushk scaly jild; bony endoskeleton amphibians se sakht aur khopri lambi; pehli do cervical vertebrae (atlas aur axis) sar ko zyada harkat deti hain; ventricle left aur right mein adhoora taqseem; ectothermic aur poikilothermic; andaruni fertilization; oviparous. Aaj ke reptiles: lizards, snakes, tuatara aur crocodiles.

book_ref.quote: Reptiles are the first animal group that possess amniotic eggs

blocks.prompt:
22 Describe the adaptations of birds for flight and their respiratory system. (4 marks)
(Parindon ki urne ke liye mutabiqat aur un ka respiratory system bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Urne ki mutabiqat:
1. Par (feathers) urne ki satah banate hain jo lift aur rukh badalne mein madad dete hain; garmi aur paani ke zayaa ko bhi rokte hain.
2. Jism streamlined aur takle (spindle) jaisa; agle limbs paron (wings) mein badle hue.
3. Bare hawai khanon ki wajah se haddiyan halki; daanton ki jagah halka ghilaf, chonch (bill).
4. Sternum par bari haddi keel jis se urne ke muscles jurte hain.
5. Endotherms aur homeotherms: andaruni garmi se taqreeban yaksan core temperature; chaar khanon wala dil, atria aur ventricles poori tarah alag.

Respiratory system: bahari nathne nasal raston se pharynx mein khulte hain; pharynx se trachea aur phir bronchi. Awaz ka organ syrinx trachea ke nichle sire par hai. Bronchi air sacs ke pechida nizam tak jati hain jo jism ka bara hissa gherte aur kuch haddiyon tak jate hain. Air sacs phephron se jude hain jo parabronchi naam ki chhoti hawai nalkiyon se bane hain.

book_ref.quote: The body of birds is streamlined and spindle shaped

blocks.prompt:
23 Mammals are the most advanced vertebrates. (i) Give the main characteristics of mammals. (ii) Describe the three groups of mammals with examples. (4 marks)
(Mammals sab se taraqqi yafta vertebrates hain. (i) Mammals ki bunyadi khususiyaat likhein. (ii) Mammals ke teen groups misaalon ke saath bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Khususiyaat: maa ke mammary glands ke doodh se parwarish; jism par baal; epidermis se bane skin glands: sebaceous (tel) aur sudoriferous (paseena, bukharati thandak); madah mein mammary glands kaam karte hain. Zyada tar ke doodh ke aur pakke daant. Bahari kaan (pinna); middle ear mein incus, malleus aur stapes. Endothermic aur homoeothermic; chaar khanon wala dil; muscular diaphragm thoracic aur abdominal cavities ko alag karta hai; larynx (vocal cords) aur epiglottis; andaruni fertilization.

(ii) Groups:
1. Ande dene wale mammals (oviparous): embryo ki poori nashonuma ande mein. Australia mein, jaise duckbill platypus, echidna (spiny anteater).
2. Marsupials: madah ke pait par thaili (marsupium); adhoore bachche paida karte hain jo thaili mein nashonuma mukammal karte hain. Yeh viviparous hain (book correction; kitab inhen ovoviviparous kehti hai). Misalein: opossum, kangaroo, Tasmanian wolf.
3. Placental mammals: sab se taraqqi yafta; uterus wall aur foetus ke darmiyan placenta banta hai jis se foetus ko ghiza milti aur fuzla nikalta hai. Viviparous. Misalein: dolphin, rat, monkey, bat, elephant, insaan.

book_ref.quote: Mammalia includes the group of vertebrates which are nourished by milk

blocks.prompt:
24 Viruses are classified separately from living organisms. (i) Why are viruses not placed in any domain or kingdom? (ii) Classify viruses on the basis of host range, with examples. (4 marks)
(Viruses ki classification jaandaar organisms se alag hai. (i) Viruses ko kisi domain ya kingdom mein kyun nahi rakha jata? (ii) Host range ki bunyad par viruses ki classification misaalon ke saath likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Viruses ko organisms nahi mana jata kyun ke woh acellular hain (cells se nahi bane). In mein teenon domains ki khususiyaat nahi, is liye kisi domain ya kingdom mein nahi rakhe jate. Virus protein ke khol mein nucleic acid (DNA ya RNA) hai; khud metabolism nahi chala sakta aur nakal aur protein banane ke liye host cell par inhisar karta hai. Classification ICTV ke mutabiq hai.

(ii) Host range par:
1. Animal viruses: janwaron aur insanon ko infect. Misalein: influenza virus, rabies virus.
2. Plant viruses: paudon ko infect. Misalein: tobacco mosaic virus, potato virus X.
3. Bacteriophages: bacteria ko infect. Misalein: T4 phage, Lambda phage.
4. Archaea viruses: archaea ko infect. Misaal: Sulfolobus spindle-shaped virus.

book_ref.quote: They lack any of the characteristics of the three domains of life

blocks.prompt:
25 Describe three methods used to assess the distribution of organisms in an area, with an example of each. (4 marks)
(Kisi ilaqe mein organisms ki taqseem jaanchne ke teen tareeqe, har aik ki misaal ke saath, bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Quadrat sampling: ilaqe ko grid mein taqseem kar ke random chune hue squares (quadrats) mein sampling. Paudon ya aik jagah jame organisms ke liye khaas mufeed. Misaal: jangal mein muqarrar size ke quadrats laga kar har paude ki species ki mojoodgi ya ghair mojoodgi record karna.

2. Transect sampling: ilaqe mein line ya patti (transect) bichha kar baqaida faslon par species record karna. Mukhtalif mahol mein species ki taqseem ke liye mufeed. Misaal: sahil par high tide line se low tide line tak transect se intertidal organisms ki qisam aur kasrat record karna.

3. Aerial surveys: aircraft ya drones se bare ilaqon mein organisms ki taqseem dekhna aur record karna. Misaal: bari wetland mein parindon ki species ya savannas mein bare mammals ki aabaadi ki nigrani.

book_ref.quote: It involves laying out a line or strip (transect) across the study area

blocks.prompt:
26 Describe the methods used to assess the abundance of organisms. (4 marks)
(Organisms ki kasrat (abundance) jaanchne ke tareeqe bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Point counts: aik muqarrar jagah se muqarrar waqt tak species ke afraad gin kar record karna; parindon aur harkat karne wale janwaron ke liye aam.
2. Mark-recapture: afraad ko pakar kar, nishan laga kar chhorna, phir baad mein dobara pakar kar aabaadi ka size aur ghanapan andaza karna; un janwaron ke liye jinhen seedha ginna mushkil ho.
3. Quadrat counts: har quadrat mein species ke afraad gin kar kul kasrat ka andaza.
4. Capture-recapture methods: aise models jo pakre jane ke mukhtalif imkanaat aur ilaqon ke darmiyan harkat jaise mutaghayyirat ka hisaab rakhte hain.
5. Remote sensing: satellite ya drone tasweeron se kasrat aur taqseem ka andaza, khaas taur par bare ya na-qabil-e-rasai ilaqon mein.

book_ref.quote: Point counts involve observing and recording the number of individuals of a species

blocks.prompt:
27 New species arise in different ways. (i) Define speciation. (ii) Explain peripatric and parapatric speciation with examples. (4 marks)
(Nayi species mukhtalif tareeqon se banti hain. (i) Speciation ki definition likhein. (ii) Peripatric aur parapatric speciation misaalon ke saath samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Speciation woh evolutionary amal hai jis se mushtarka jadd se nayi species banti hain. Is mein genetic tabdeeliyan jama hoti hain jo aabaadiyon ke darmiyan reproductive isolation paida karti hain.

(ii) Peripatric speciation: bari aabaadi ke kinare par aik chhoti, alag aabaadi. Chhoti aabaadi mein tez evolutionary tabdeeliyan hoti hain aur woh asal aabaadi se alag ho jati hai. Misaal: chhoti bani aabaadi se banne wali island species.

Parapatric speciation: jab aabaadiyan saath saath hon magar gradient par mukhtalif mahol mein rahen. In ke darmiyan gene flow kam hota hai aur har aik apne mahol ke mutabiq dhalti hai; waqt ke saath reproductive isolation ho sakti hai. Misaal: ghaas Anthoxanthum odoratum jo gradient par mukhtalif mitti ke mutabiq dhali aur mukhtalif mitti mein reproductive isolation paida hui.

book_ref.quote: An example can be seen in island species that evolve from a small founding population

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Peripatric mein chhoti aabaadi kinare par alag ho jati hai (founding population); parapatric mein aabaadiyan saath saath rehti hain magar mahol (gradient) mukhtalif hai, is liye gene flow kam ho jata hai.
